pages.text: The Life Activator neutralizes exhausted fuel (100 Life Energy per mb), 1:1 into activated exhausted liquid.$(br)Waste pipes feed the input tank; normal liquid pipes pull from the output tank.
The Life Centrifuge separates activated fuel into main product and byproduct.$(br)The Activated Fractionator further refines activated components - the path to plasma and fusion.
The Item Reconstructor rebuilds items from exhausted crystals - waste becomes useful again.
